id: enforcement-Deterministic Container Testing with Output-Based Validation in Kubectx Sandbox

content.specificationName: Deterministic Container Testing with Output-Based Validation in Kubectx Sandbox

changesApplied.changeMade: Created single validation framework with ImpulseLoader, CommandExecutor, OutputComparator, and UnifiedOutputValidator classes
changesApplied.reason: Consolidates 100+ validation harnesses into single output-comparison engine with zero LLM dependency. All assertions are deterministic boolean (===, !==, >, <, contains, regex). Loads expected outputs from impulses instead of hardcoded values.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Foundation component - enables all other validation to migrate to deterministic output-based approach. Eliminates redundant HTTP clients, kubectl wrappers, and assertion logic across harnesses.

changesApplied.changeMade: Created parameterized container build script supporting metabob-rpc-api, metabob-cli, metabob-opencode with automated tagging and exit code validation
changesApplied.reason: Standardizes container builds across all repos, eliminates duplicate build logic (build-and-deploy-devbob-k8s.sh inline Dockerfile, build-devbob.sh), enables automated build-deploy-validate workflow
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Replaces multiple repo-specific build scripts. Provides consistent tagging for sandbox testing. Validates build success with exit codes. Outputs structured image metadata for downstream scripts.

pendingChanges.impactAnalysis: Critical for sandbox isolation - prevents tests from running against production

pendingChanges.reason: Required to automate test execution with impulse-based validation and result aggregation
pendingChanges.impactAnalysis: Completes automation workflow: build → deploy → test → validate → pass/fail
